get.description:
Lists the requisition compliance documents

**Procore Pay must be enabled to use this endpoint.**

parameters.name: status[]
parameters.description:
Return only compliance documents in the given statuses. Repeat the parameter to filter on more than one status. Omit it to return documents in every status.

Example usage:

        ?status[]=not_compliant&status[]=in_review&status[]=revision_needed

Documents still stored under a legacy status are matched by the current equivalent — `not_compliant` also returns `not_submitted` documents, `in_review` also returns `review_pending`, `revision_needed` also returns `revise_and_resubmit`, and `compliant` also returns `approved`. The legacy values themselves are not accepted as filter values.

A value outside the enum returns `400 Bad Request`.

parameters.name: allow_vendor_submission
parameters.description: Return only compliance documents whose vendor submission setting matches the given value. Omit it to return documents regardless of the setting.

x-changelog.summary: Add allow_vendor_submission field to invoice compliance documents
x-changelog.description: The `allow_vendor_submission` field is now included in all API responses for invoice compliance documents (list, show, create, update). It can also be passed in both create and update requests. When the vendor submission feature flag is enabled, commitment admins can toggle this field to control whether vendors can submit compliance documents.

x-changelog.summary: Add status and allow_vendor_submission filters to the invoice compliance documents list endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The list endpoint now accepts optional `status[]` and `allow_vendor_submission` query parameters, which can be used on their own or together.
`status[]` may be repeated to match several statuses, for example `?status[]=not_compliant&status[]=in_review&status[]=revision_needed`.
Documents still stored under a legacy status are matched by the current equivalent, so `compliant` also returns documents stored as `approved`.
A status outside the documented list returns a 400.
Omitting the parameters preserves the existing unfiltered behavior.

x-changelog.summary: Add required_for_vendor_submission field to the invoice compliance documents list and show responses
x-changelog.description:
The `required_for_vendor_submission` field is now returned by:
`GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/invoices/{invoice_id}/documents` (list)
`GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/invoices/{invoice_id}/documents/{document_id}` (show)
When true, the vendor must submit this compliance document before they can submit an invoice. Only applicable when `allow_vendor_submission` is true. Defaults to false.
The field is returned only; it is not yet accepted in create or update requests.

x-changelog.summary: Add compliance_document_requirement_id to invoice compliance document responses
x-changelog.description:
List, show, create, and update now return `compliance_document_requirement_id`.
It contains the parent document requirement ID for documents created from a template and is null for manually created documents.

x-changelog.summary: Add notes field to invoice compliance document create and update requests
x-changelog.description:
The `notes` field can now be passed in create and update requests for invoice compliance documents.
Only commitment admins can update `notes` on existing invoice compliance documents.

x-changelog.summary: Add status field to invoice compliance document create request
x-changelog.description:
The `status` field can now be passed in create requests for invoice compliance documents.
When the vendor submission feature flag is enabled, `status` is required — omitting it returns a 400.
When the flag is disabled, the field is ignored and status is auto-determined based on file attachment presence.

x-changelog.summary: Add required_for_vendor_submission field to invoice compliance document create and update requests
x-changelog.description:
The `required_for_vendor_submission` field can now be passed in the request body for:
`POST /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/invoices/{invoice_id}/documents` (create)
`PATCH /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/compliance/invoices/{invoice_id}/documents/{document_id}` (update)
When true, the vendor must submit this compliance document before they can submit an invoice. It is only applicable when the effective `allow_vendor_submission` is true and is forced to false otherwise. Defaults to false on create.
Only commitment admins can change this value on an existing document; other users receive a 400 error.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"name\":\"Document One\",\"document_type\":\"bond\",\"status\":\"approved\",\"reviewer_notes\":\"Reviewer Notes\",\"notes\":\"GC notes\",\"prostore_file_ids\":[\"123456\"],\"effective_at\":\"2021-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\"expires_at\":\"2021-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\"allow_vendor_submission\":true,\"required_for_vendor_submission\":false}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/compliance/invoices/%7Binvoice_id%7D/documents/%7Bdocument_id%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

The `name` and `document_type` fields can now be passed in update requests for invoice compliance documents.
